{parātrīśikālaghuvṛttiḥ} |
{mahāmāheśvarācāryavarya (-) śrīmadabhinavaguptaracitā} |
yatra tejasi tejāṃsi tamāṃsi ca tamasyalam | tejāṃsi ca tamāṃsyetadvande jyotiranuttaram || 1 ||
sadāgamapravāheṣu bahudhā vyākṛtaṃ trikam | śrīmadutpaladevīyaṃ tantrasāraṃ tu varṇyate || 2 ||
sadābhinavaguptaṃ yatpurāṇaṃ ca prasiddhimat | hṛdayaṃ tatparollāsaiḥ svayaṃ sphūrjatyanuttaram || 3 ||
tatra svātmadevataiva prabuddhyamānāvasthāyāṃ svātmānaṃ parāmarśośenāvatarantaṃ pṛcchatiṃ | tata ucyate śrīdevyuvāca iti | kiṃ pṛcchati (?) tadāha (-)
anuttaraṃ kathaṃ deva svataḥ kaulikasiddhidam | yena vijñātamātreṇa khecarīsamatāṃ vrajet || 1 ||
he svātmarūpa deva sarvatra jñāne karaṇe ca prathamamabhimukhībhūta(,) tava tāvadanuttaraṃ rūpam uttaram utkṛṣṭamuparivarti(,) tacca jaḍāpekṣayā grāhakarūpam | tasya tu cidātmanaḥ svaprakāśasya na grāhakāntaramastīti anuttaratvam |
tena anuttaraṃ saṃvidrūpaṃ sadā sarvatrāvabhāsitaṃ pūrvāparadeśakālavihīnamanapahnavanīyam(,) kiṃ tatrocyatām | idaṃ tu tatrocyate tatkila kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa kaulikasya kulasamūhasya dehākṣabhuvanādeḥ apūrvarūpasya svataḥ svatantrataḥ siddhiṃ ubhayendriyasaṃvedyatayā abhivyaktiṃ dadāti(,) dā dāne do'vakhaṇḍane iti ca dhātugatyā sṛjati saṃharati cetyarthaḥ | anuttaraṃ cidekarūpaṃ sat kathaṃ navanavena ata eva paryanuyojyena vedyavedanavedakādibhedena bhātītyarthaḥ | nanu kimetena | jñātenānena prakāreṇa jñātamātreṇa khecarī bodhabhūmisaṃcāriṇī satī iyaṃ saṃvicchaktiḥ (1)samatām avikalpatvaṃ pūrṇatvamātmano vrajet gacchejjānīyāt | (2)tatprakārāparijñāne tu na khecarī abodharūpe vedyāṃśe saṃcaraṇāt | tata eva vedyaiḥ nīlādibhirniyantriteti na pūrṇaśaktiḥ | kiṃca dhāraṇādikrameṇa prāṇayogādikṛtāḥ siddhayaḥ santi anuttaraṃ saṃvinmātrarūpamakramaṃ kathaṃ kaulikasiddhiṃ sakramāṃ dadāti yena jñātamātreṇa devīrūpatvaṃ vrajet || 1 ||
etad guhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ kathaya sva mama prabho | hṛdayasthā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulinī kulanāyikā || 2 ||
tāṃ me kathaya deveśa yena tṛptiṃ vrajāmyaham |
etadaprakaṭamatiśayena mahat utkṛṣṭamaguhyaṃ svaprakāśaṃ yathā bhavati tathā kṛtvā prabho (3)ācchādane svarūpasya prakaṭane ca prabhavanaśīla he sva svātman mama pṛcchantyāḥ saṃvidaḥ
(1tatsamatāmiti pāṭhāntaram |) (2tatprakāre'parijñāte tu iti pāṭhāntaram |) (3nijasvarūpasyācchādakaprakaṭananocchādanaikarūpa(,) prakaṭanena ca pramātṛrūpatvātprabhavanaśīleti pāṭhāntaram |)
kathaya vimarśapadavīṃ (1)vākyaprabandhaparyantatāmānaya | nanu grāhakarūpaṃ sarvasya hṛdaye sphurati tatra kiṃ praśnena | (2)satyaṃ(,) sphuritamapi na tattvato hṛdayaṅgamībhūtam | hṛdayaṅgamībhāvena vinā bhātamapyabhātameva rathyāgamane tṛṇaparṇādivat | hṛdayaṅgamatāvagamanasādhyā hi tṛptirjīvanmuktatā(,) tatsamāveśasādhyā hi tṛptirvibhūtirūpeti dvividhā tṛptiḥ parāmarśena vinā na bhavatīti yukta eva praśnaḥ | tadeva darśayati hṛdayasthā hṛdaye saṃvidrūpe sthitā yā svātantryalakṣaṇā śaktiryasyāḥ kulaṃ grāhyagrāhakagrahaṇacakraṃ nirmeyatvena prayojanaṃ tata eva kaulinī | tasya nirmitasya kulasya nāyikā sā adhiṣṭhātrī(,) tadvedanena tadavabhāsanakartrī ca tatsvarūpasaṃhartrī ca | tāṃ me kathaya parāmarśapadavīṃ naya | yena parāmṛśyatānayanena tṛptiṃ bhuktimuktirūpāṃ vrajāmyahamiti saṃvedanarūpāṃ kathayeti ṇicau | evaṃ prabuddhyamānarūpā saṃvit yadā praśnaṃ nirbhṛtāvabhāsamānaparamārthasvarūpaṃ karoti tadā prabuddhāvasthāpratipattau saiva pūrṇarūpā bhairavadevatātmikā prativacanadātrī saṃpadyate | naca (3)atra aidaṃprāthamikatvaṃ kadācit apitu purātanameva tatparamāvartamānaṃ kālabhedakalpanayā bhātīti bhūtatvena vyavahriyate || 2 ||
(5)divyarūpatvena pratyakṣābhāvātparokṣeṇa tadetaducyate
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇu devi mahābhāge uttarasyāpyanuttaram || 3 ||
kathayāmi na sandehaḥ sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam |
(1vākyajanyaparyantatāmiti pāṭhāntaram |) (2satyaṃ sphuratīti pāṭhāntaram |) (3na cātrecchāṃ prāthamikīṃ kācidityapi pāṭhaḥ |) (4vedyatvena cetyapi pāṭhaḥ |)
kauliko'yaṃ vidhirdevi mama hṛdvyomnyavasthitaḥ || 4 ||
(1)mahān bhāgaḥ prabuddhatvāvasthāyāmujjigamiṣālakṣaṇā yasyāḥ sā tvamevaṃbhūtā śṛṇu sphuṭamavadhāraya | (2)ahamuttarasyāpi grāhakasyāpi yadanuttaraṃ rūpam | apiśabdād grāhyagrahaṇāderapi | kaulikasiddhidaṃ (3)viśvāvabhāsanādibhogāpavargatṛptiprayojanaṃ | tatkathayāmi tacca hṛdayaṅgamatāṃ nayāmi | yathā sadya eva avadhāraṇamātre saṃpanne eva punaratra sandeho na bhavati | yasmāt ayamiti bhāsamāno yaḥ kauliko vidhiḥ sa mama hṛdayākāśe hṛdayatvena sadā viditaḥ san cidātmatayā tāvadāste |
sadeva saumyedamagra (....) ekamevādvitīyaṃ (....) tadaikṣata
ityādiśruteḥ || 4 ||
tataśca
athādyāstithayaḥ sarvāḥ svarā bindvavasānakāḥ | tadantaḥ kālayogena somasūryau prakīrtitau || 5 ||
pṛthivyādīni tattvāni puruṣāntāni pañcasu | kramātkādiṣu vargeṣu makārānteṣu suvrate || 6 ||
vāyvagnisalilendrāṇāṃ dhāraṇānāṃ catuṣṭayam | tadūrdhve śādi vikhyātaṃ purastād brahmapañcakam || 7 ||
amūlā tatkramā jñeyā kṣāntā sṛṣṭirudāhṛtā | sarveṣāṃ caiva mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ ca yaśasvini || 8 ||
<1mahānubhavaikaprabuddheti pāṭhāntaram |) (2yato'hamukrasyeti pāṭhāntaram |) (3viśvāvabhāsakādibhogeti pāṭhāntaram |)
iyaṃ yoniḥ samākhyātā sarvatantreṣu sarvadā |
iha padārthaprakāśanameva tāvat saṃvedanaṃ prasiddham(,) padārthaśca jñātṛjñeyasvabhāvaḥ(,) tatra jñātṛtā nāma unmeṣanimeṣalakṣaṇena saṃkocavikāsātmajñānakriyālakṣaṇena svabhāvena svaparispandanasārā natu pariniṣṭhitā | paricchinnajaḍarūpaghaṭāditulyasya ca saṃkocavikāsayogaḥ katham | trikoṇaṃ hṛdayaspandanādiṣu yathāyathā sphuṭībhavati tathātathā jñātṛtvamutkṛṣyate | (1)yā bahiriva saṃvidi yathāyathā nyūnībhavati(,) tathātathā tannikṛṣyate | yāvajjaḍapāṣāṇādau svayaṃ saṃkocavikāsalakṣaṇo visargaḥ svātantryātmā bhagavato'nuttarasya śaktiḥ | tena bhairavasaṃghaṭṭaviśramaṇodayaparamārthaśivaśaktisvarūpaṃ rudrayāmalamucyate | saṃkocavikāsayoge eva madhye anuttaraḥ(,) ānandaḥ(,) icchā(,) īśanā(,) unmeṣaḥ(,) ūnatā(,) iccheśanayorasphuṭasphuṭavedyollāsaḥ ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ bhavati(,) tayoriccheśanayoranuttarānanvābhyāṃ sandhiyamānatvāt e ai(,) unmeṣonatayostābhyāmeva tathākṛtatvāt o au iti bhavati(,) tadanantaraṃ vedyajātasya vedakātmakabindusvarūpasaṃskāraśeṣatvabhityanena rūpeṇa paripūrṇaṃ(2) bhavati(,) ityevaṃ pūrṇānandacidrūpa(3)visargaśaktimayaṃ parabhairavayāmalam | tatra visargarūpatā sāmānyākārā viśeṣeṣu pañcadaśasviti pṛthag gaṇanārhā na bhavati | evaṃ kauliko vidhirmama tāvad hṛdi saṃvidrūpatādātmyenāvasthitaḥ | athānantara (4)midaṃparāmarśamahimnā prasaranti ye akārādyā binduparyantāḥ
(1jñātṛtetyarthaḥ |) (2pūrṇo bhavatityapi pāṭhaḥ |) (3visargaśaktimayaparabhairaveti pāṭhāntaram |) (4idamiti padaṃ nāsti ka. pustake |)
svarāḥ(,) ta eva paramānandarūpasya sthitiṃ pūrayantīti tithaya uktāḥ | evaṃ sā bodhacandrasya prakāśānandamayasyānuttarasya vimarśaśaktiḥ pañcadaśabhistithibhiḥ pūryate | te caite sarve svarāḥ śabdanasvarūpāḥ (1)paramārthātmāno jagadapekṣayā svayaṃ rājantaḥ svaprakāśāḥ teṣāmantaḥ somasūryau saṃkocavikāsau tadātmā teṣāṃ tadantaḥ teṣāmantaḥ bindudvayātmā visarga iti yāvat | tataḥ sarveṣveteṣu kālena saṃkalanātmanā parāmarśanayogaḥ | tato hetoḥ | parāmarśo hi spandanātmaiva(,) natu pariniṣṭhitācalajaḍarūpaḥ | bahirapi ca somasūryau rātridivasasaṃkocavikāsarūpeṇa tithipañcadaśakasya antaḥ (2)carataḥ iti | iyaṃ sā bhagavatī parāmarśaśaktiḥ | yaśca asāvicchāyāmīśane ca vedyollāsaḥ sa eva pṛthagbhavan sthūlatayā bhūtapañcakātmā sūkṣmatvena ca tanmātrapañcakātmeti daśa tattvāni(,) pṛthivī jalaṃ tejovāyurākāśaḥ gandho raso rūpaṃ sparśaḥ śabda iti | sa eva vedyollāsaḥ karaṇatayā sṛjyamānānīndriyāṇi tattatkriyāśaktipradhānāni upasthapāyupādapāṇivāgādīni karmendriyāṇi (3)jñānaśaktipradhānāni buddhindriyāṇi ghrāṇarasanācakṣustvakśrotramiti | tato vedyatāyāḥ krameṇa saṃsāre vedanābhasasyollāse mano'haṃkāraḥ buddhiḥ pradhānaṃ purusaḥ | tathā pṛthivyādīni puruṣāntāni kādiṣu māntaṣviti | puruṣasya ca (4)saṃvedyarūpasyaivopari māntasya vedyarāśau gaṇanam | tena hi vinā pṛthivyādi vedyaṃ kathaṃ bhavet | (5)tena vedyābhāsasyaiveyadrūpaṃ yadvedyarāśereva atyaktavedyabhāvasya bhinna (-)
(1paramārthātmano iti pāṭhāntaram |) (2tithipañcadaśakasyāntaḥ carantaḥ iti pāṭhāntaram |) (3jñānaśaktiprādhānyānīti pāṭhāntaram |) (4 saṃvedyarūpasyaivoparimaṇasyetyapi pāṭhaḥ |) (5na vedyābhāsasyaivedaṃ rūpamiti pāṭhāntaram |)
vedyavedakaikīkaraṇam | tadvyāvṛttāni tattvāni | kalāḥ vāyurūpā kiṃcit kartṛtvena prerikā | aśuddhavidyā tejorūpā kiṃcijjñatvena prakāśikā ca | māyā salilarūpā abhiṣvaṅgarūpanimajjanātmakastambhanasvabhāvā | indropalakṣitā pṛthivīrūpā rāgaśaktiḥ | tā etāścatasraḥ śaktayaḥ puruṣaṃ dhārayanti madhye triśaṅkuvada(1)viśramayanti(,) anyathā pāṣāṇādivat jaḍabhumimevāpatetparameśvaravadvā saṃvidgaganamevāpatet | ubhayathāpi māyāpramātṛtābhāve vedyamapi na kiṃciditi(,) saṃkocavikāsāvapi na kaucit(,) saṃkocena vinā (2)vikāsasyāpyayogāt | tadvisargarūpeṇa saṃkocavikāsātmanā idaṃ sarvamākṣiptaṃ | yat (3)vedyasṛṣṭiḥ samuci(di)tavedakasṛṣṭiśceti | ākāśaśaktayā(4) tu nātra māyāpramātṛtādhāne prayojanamasti | sā hi antarlīnā puruṣasya (5)vedyaśūnyatayā vedyāvakāśasahiṣṇutayā ca (6)pramātṛtvāt tadīyā nityā vimarśaśaktiḥ | yadā tu vedyatāyāḥ krameṇa prachādanaṃ saṃvidrūpasya ca prathanaṃ tatra tāvat dhṛtiḥ(,) tadrūpasyaiva āpyāyanaṃ tatprakāśayogaḥ | tatraiva paramasvātantryalābhātmakaṃ spandanaṃ sarvatra tenaiva rūpeṇa vyāptam | ityetad bṛṃhakaṃ svarūpasya pūrakaṃ vyāpakaṃ pañcakaṃ śādīnāṃ vidyeśvarasadāśivaśaktiśivalakṣaṇaṃ sūkṣmapṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśarūpaṃ(,) sadyojātavāmadevāghoratatpuruṣeśānarūpaṃ brahmapañcakaśabdenākhyātamiti | evamasau (7)parāpararūpā (8)visargaśaktiḥ | tathābhūtañca (9)pañcakarūpaṃ punarapyanuttaraviśrāntam | tadevaṃ (10)visargaśaktireva athādyā
(1viśrāmayantīti pāṭhāntaram |) (2vikāsasyāpyabhāvāditi pāṭhāntaram |) (3vedyasṛṣṭiśceti iti pāṭhāntaram |) (4ākāśaśaktyātmeti pāṭhāntaram |) (5vedyatveti pāṭhāntaram |) (6pramātṛrūpatvāditi pāṭhāntaram |) (7śrīparāpararūpeti pāṭhāntaram |) (8vimarśaśaktiḥ iti pāṭhāntaram |) (9bhūtapañcakarūpamiti pāṭhāntaram |) (10tathaiva vimarśaśaktimayamityapi pāṭhaḥ |)
ityādinā brahmapañcakam ityantenaiva vapuṣā vikasatīti | tadidaṃ śakticakramavicchinnaprabandhaṃ bhagavato bhairavanāthasya | anuttarecchonmeṣatrikoṇa(1)visargaśaktayaḥ eva hi pañcabhedavatya(2)ścidānandecchājñānakriyāśaktayo vācyabhūtapañcakaśaktimayyaḥ iti | tataśca sarvametadavibhāgaparāmarśarūpaṃ prathamataḥ tato vibhāgaparāmarśātmanā pañcāśadvimarśarūpaṃ parāmṛśyarūpeṇa tu (3)karmatāṃ prāptaṃ bahistattvajālaṃ jāyate | tasya parāmarśātmataiva jīvitam | sā ca mātṛkārūpā | ata eva sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ guptārthabhājāṃ (4)bījapiṇḍātmanāṃ catuṣkalanavātmādīnāṃ puruṣarūpavācyādhyavasitānāñca vidyānāṃ saṃvedyamānasphuṭārtharūpāṇāṃ namaḥśivāya ityādimālāmantrāṇāṃ strīrupavācyādhyavasitānāṃ ca sarveṣāmiyaṃ yoniḥ avibhāgaparāmarśatārūpaṃ kāraṇaṃ | sarveṣu śivarudrādirahasyatantreṣu yatkiṃciducyate tatsarvaṃ ita evodeti | (5)yatkila parāvara(6)siddhidaṃ rūpaṃ tatsarvaṃ tattvaṣaṭtriṃśatyāṃ(7) labhyate | tasyāśca parāmṛśyaṃ yajjaḍarūpaṃ śarīrasthānīyaṃ tasya parāmarśatā jīvitaṃ(,) sā ca asyāṃ bhagavatyāmiti ithameva sarvaṃ dadāti | ata eveha bhagavatyāḥ praṣṭurūpatvam | anayaiva hṛdayaṅgamatayā yaśasvini iti (8)prasiddham | iyatā viśvātmarūpeṇa prasiddhā jāteti yaśasvinītyāmantraṇam | eṣā ca sā trividhā sṛṣṭirakāramūlā kṣakāraparyantā anuttararūpā (9)prasūtiḥ punarapi śivātmanyeva(10) viśrāntidvāreṇa
(1vimarśaśaktaya iti pāṭhāntaram |) (2paṃcabhedavata iti pāṭhāntaram |) (3tūttaratāṃ prāptamiti pāṭhāntaram |) (4bījātmagatānāmiti pāṭhāntaram |) (5yatkiṃciditi pāṭhāntaram |) (6parāsiddhirūpamiti pāṭhāntaram |) (7triṃśatyetipāṭhāntaram |) (8prasiddhamiti iti pāṭhāntaram |) (9anuttararūpātprabhṛti iti pāṭhāntaram |) (10śivātmanyevānuttaradhāmni iti pāṭhāntaram |)
tatraivānuttaradhāmni viśramaṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathābhūtā udāhṛtā jñeyā satī | anayābhijñātayā tadanuttaraspandasvarūpaṃ suṣṭhu jñātaṃ bhavatīti yatkila tadanuttaramiti yāvat | evaṃ hṛdayasthā pūrvamavibhāgaparāmarśarūpā (1)śaktiḥ vibhāgaparāmarśatāṃ kaulikasiddhirūpatāmanenaivānuttararūpasvātaṃtryeṇa pratipadyate iti nirṇītaṃ śivarudrarahasyāditantreṣu || 8 ||
nanvavibhāgaparā(2)marśe pṛthagvibhāgaparāmarśamūlabhūte hṛdayasvarūpe (3)sati na nivṛttaḥ sandehaḥ (?) ityāśaṅkyādiśati
caturdaśayutaṃ bhadre tithīśāntasamanvitam | tṛtīyaṃ brahma suśroṇi hṛdayaṃ bhairavātmanaḥ || 9 ||
